name: agent-qa
description: Local MCP server for web and mobile QA with memidex persistent memory, validated self-improvement, and reviewable run evidence.
examples: Configure agent-qa and a model provider in a project, then start the stdio MCP server with npx agent-qa mcp from that project.
Use an MCP client to create and run web or mobile tests, inspect recorded evidence, and review project memory.

requirements.other: A configured model provider or compatible local model; mobile testing also requires Appium and the platform SDK, with macOS and Xcode for iOS. Model and external-service charges are separate.

features: Web, Android, and iOS test execution through CLI and MCP interfaces
memidex persistent memory across test runs
Validated self-improvement grounded in verified run evidence
Reviewable test results and recorded evidence
